verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a Smart Formatting parameter (smart_format=true) that formats currency amounts, phone numbers, email addresses and more. Because it is a request parameter, formatting can be toggled per request, which covers the number-formatting part of the story and implies the ability to turn it off. missing for 10: explicit evidence of punctuation and casing output, documentation that formatting is on by default or of how to disable it, and independent or hands-on corroboration of formatting quality.
